title: Three women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember three women from Lombardy and Liguria. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold each of them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Rosalba Persico
tribute: Rosalba Persico, 84, from Milan in Lombardy, is in our thoughts.

women.name: Maria Ursache
tribute: Maria Ursache, 63, from Rapallo in Liguria, is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Lecco
tribute: A woman aged 42 from Lecco in Lombardy is in our thoughts.
